report:
Reviewed the complete point-excerpts claim, the ordinary evidence.rs association, the ordinary point_excerpts_include_five_following_lines_and_truncate_at_eof test, and the TODO point_excerpts_and_surrounding_source test. Independently verified historical whole-file comparisons: both test files match exactly; evidence.rs differs only by an added meta.reviews.decisions association comment on placeholder_status, which does not change excerpt behavior. Historical approval is context, not execution evidence.

Source assessment: marker() recognizes an empty suffix as a point (region=false), whereas << selects a region. index_source includes the marker's full line, computes min(line+5, line count), and copies the exact source span. Lines excludes an artificial extra line after a terminal newline and bounds the final span at source length. Thus the preview includes five following lines when available and truncates at EOF. The ordinary test visibly asserts non-region classification, line range 1..6, exact CRLF-preserving excerpt excluding the sixth following line, span/excerpt equality, a shortened EOF excerpt without terminal newline, and a marker-only final line with terminal newline. These assertions detect an off-by-one preview or erroneous EOF range; the captured index helper supplies the source to CorrespondenceIndex. The complete implementation file, rather than its five-line navigation preview, was assessed, consistent with the claim's qualification that previews do not delimit implementation.

The explicit TODO test remains empty and is not behavioral coverage. Its See more/surrounding-source portion remains an accepted deferred UI/navigation verification, requiring a rendered source-view fixture and an action test establishing that opening See more reaches the marker in surrounding source beyond the preview. The TODO also names extraction/EOF checks already substantively supplied by the ordinary test; it does not negate that ordinary evidence. No completion of the deferred navigation guarantee is claimed. This preserves the historical justified deferral without silently upgrading it to implemented/tested status.

Executed review start, captured review rules and the test fixture helper with review read, inspected all initial fragments and compared baseline bytes. No behavioral test or build was run by this reviewer; the coordinator-reported 321 passing tests and root build are separate execution evidence. No source edits or newly reproduced failure. All claim aspects are accounted for by inspected extraction behavior/assertions or the explicit remaining TODO.
